Handed to the team · Waiting on RMA label and a reply to his Sunday message; I cannot issue RMA label

I've got it, Zach. The NerdQX on Shop···· was delivered August 10, and your RMA is in. Sorry you've been left hanging on both.

I've pinged the team now so your RMA gets picked up and the return label sent. Stay in the chat and one of them will jump in here, and if you step away the answer comes to your email.

One thing I need to ask: was the unit ever overclocked or modified?
Nope never overclocked or modified

Good, that keeps it straightforward. Stock and untouched means it's covered, so the RMA runs as normal: label to you, then up to 10 days processing once the unit lands at the warehouse.

While you wait, if you want a second opinion on the fault itself, our Discord is the fastest route, JD (@nullhashrate) is active there: https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf

What's it actually doing, no power, dropping off, or hashing wrong?
Two codes, vreg overheated and voltage protection

That pair usually points at the voltage regulator losing cooling or the PSU sagging, so the board trips protection before it can hash. Quickest check: make sure the VREG heatsink fan is spinning and clear, and try a different PSU or wall outlet if you have one spare.

If it still trips, that's a board fault and the RMA is the right path, which you've already got moving.

Did it ever run clean, or was it like this from day one?
It ran pretty well from day one. A little louder than I expected.

Then it's a part that's failed, not a setup problem. A unit that ran fine for weeks and now trips on VREG temp and voltage protection is a board or regulator issue, and that's exactly what RMA covers.

Nothing more for you to do on your side. The team picks up the label and the repair or replacement from here.

Anything else while I've got you?
Nope thats it.
Used the chat-interview skill
Ran dossier.py (chat-interview skill)
Before you go, one thing: were you thinking of adding a second miner alongside the NerdQX, or waiting to see how this one went first?
Mainly got it for a desktop piece. Remind me of the white paper bitaxe from back in the day.

Makes sense, that's what the NerdQX is built for.

You mentioned it's louder than you expected. On a desk, is that something you'd put up with, or would it push you to a different unit next time?
In time i would like to upgrade to something with a ethernet cable, a little better hash rate wouldn't hurt.

Noted, wired and more hash. When you're ready I can run the real numbers for Jamestown on the units that fit, so you're not guessing.

Before you go, one thing: what's pulling you toward ethernet, has the wifi been dropping on the NerdQX?
No just want a better solo chance. Having ethernet is like having a few extra th.

Fair point, less stale work on a solo setup. Thanks for telling me, that's genuinely useful.

Your RMA is with the team and they'll come back on the label here or by email. When you're ready to look at an upgrade, just ping me and I'll run the numbers for your place. The D. worth joining too, plenty of solo miners comparing setups: https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf
Take care, Zach. Watch your inbox for the RMA label, and I'm here if anything else comes up.
Thanks
Anytime. Good luck with the solo shot.
Catch you later, Zach.
Bye
Bye, Zach.
